environment.runtime: Node backend started locally against InMemoryRepository unless stated
environment.database: MariaDB NOT available in the audit sandbox (ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:3306)
environment.providers: Firebase / Razorpay / PayPal credentials NOT available
environment.consequence: every browser-level and provider-level claim below is BLOCKED, not passed

probePathCaveat: The probe artifact stores normalised paths (concrete ids replaced by {id}), so a probe is mapped to a contract path by template shape. No probe in this set addresses any of the 11 client paths below, which is why all 11 remain BLOCKED rather than inferred.
method: Test cases are parsed from the verification-status table rather than retyped, so the manifest cannot drift from the recorded judgements. Probes come from the machine-readable probe artifact. The 11 contract defects are enumerated from the contract revalidation artifact, one test each. Blocked tests stay blocked; nothing in this environment was upgraded by inference.

tallies.neverSum: These three collections answer different questions and are never added together. No combined runtime pass rate is published.

passDefinition.contractDefect: PASS means the alleged defect was CONFIRMED by an executed request — not that the product works
passDefinition.probe: no probe is ever a pass; a probe is evidence about routing

testCases.label: contact backend validation
testCases.recordedEvidence: all four payloads (valid, short, bad email, honeypot) → `503 RATE_LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE`. Server stderr: `[Rate limit store] contact connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:3306`. Admission fails **closed** by design (`security/abuse.js:108`), so the handler is never reached

testCases.label: contact form submits
testCases.recordedEvidence: no browser; the fabricated success is a client-side `setSubmitted(true)` with no fetch (`pages/cms/index.tsx:240-244`)

testCases.label: queue telemetry + fallbacks
testCases.recordedEvidence: `GET /api/platform/queues` → **503 `QUEUE_QUERY_UNAVAILABLE`** (the exact state in which the UI keeps its fabricated baseline); `GET /api/admin/queues` → **404** (the client's own fallback URL does not exist); `POST /api/platform/queues/purge` → **410 `DEAD_LETTER_PURGE_RETIRED`**

testCases.label: queue console shows fabricated SES trace
testCases.recordedEvidence: requires rendering; the display logic (`AdminQueuesTab.tsx:114-115,154-156`) is static-proven only

testCases.label: CMS published slug
testCases.recordedEvidence: `PUT /api/admin/pages/m8b-probe-page` `{pagecontent,status:'published',expectedRevision:0}` → **200** `revision:1`; `GET /api/public/custom-pages/m8b-probe-page` → **200** with the published content

testCases.label: CMS unknown slug
testCases.recordedEvidence: `GET /api/public/custom-pages/m8b-nonexistent-slug` → **404 `CUSTOM_PAGE_NOT_FOUND`**

testCases.label: CMS unpublished visibility
testCases.recordedEvidence: after `status:'unpublished'` the public route still returned 200. **Cause is a test-double defect:** `MySQLRepository.getCustomPageBySlug` correctly applies `AND published = 1` (`MySQLRepository.js:1814-1819`); `InMemoryRepository.getCustomPageBySlug(slug)` ignores its options argument entirely (`InMemoryRepository.js:734`). Recorded as a harness finding, **not** a product defect

testCases.label: CMS renderer fetches published pages
testCases.recordedEvidence: the renderer performs no fetch at all (`pages/cms/index.tsx:38,148`); no browser available

testCases.label: blog reader routes
testCases.recordedEvidence: `GET /api/blog/posts` → **404 `API route not found`** *with a valid admin identity*, and **401** anonymously — so the 404 is confirmed and M8A's demotion of the cause can be reversed. `GET /api/blog-data` → **200**. `GET /api/blog-data/slug/m8b-missing-post` → **404 "Post not found"**

testCases.label: blog reader empty state
testCases.recordedEvidence: the swallowed-error empty state is client-side (`pages/blog/index.tsx:47-50`)

testCases.label: profile persistence
testCases.recordedEvidence: `POST /api/users-data/profile {firstname,lastname,occupation,summary,expectedRevision:0}` → **409 `STALE_WRITE` "Revision conflict"**, while `GET` → **404 `PROFILE_NOT_FOUND`** and a retry reports `remoteRevision: 0, remoteProfile: null`. A create at revision 0 conflicts with a profile the read path says does not exist

testCases.label: billing console backend
testCases.recordedEvidence: `GET /api/payment-orders` → **200** `{orders:[],source:"MARIADB_PAYMENT_ORDERS"}`; `POST /api/coupons/validate` with a fake code → **404 "does not exist"** — server validation is strict, so the fail-open is **client-side only**; `GET /api/invoices` → **503 `ECONNREFUSED`** (needs the DB)

testCases.label: billing console availability
testCases.recordedEvidence: `/dashboard/billing` and `/dashboard/plans` redirect to the public pricing page (`router.tsx:201-203,223`); no browser to confirm

testCases.label: TOTP enrolment exist?
testCases.recordedEvidence: `POST /api/users-data/mfa/enroll` → **404 `API route not found`**. Repo-wide source search finds **no** enrolment/setup/TOTP route anywhere in `backend/`. Enrolment is absent **server-side**, not merely in the UI

testCases.label: factor disable
testCases.recordedEvidence: `POST /api/users-data/mfa/disable` → **503 `IDENTITY_DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE`**; server log shows Firebase `app/invalid-credential` (no Google credentials). The route is wired and audit-logged; the identity provider is missing

testCases.label: team membership
testCases.recordedEvidence: `GET /api/enterprise/teams` and `.../teams/m8b-team/members` → **404 `ENTERPRISE_DISABLED`** ("disabled for this deployment"). Requires tenant provisioning + a config state this environment cannot set

testCases.label: employer messaging persistence
testCases.recordedEvidence: `GET /api/messages/conversations` → **403 `MODULE_DISABLED`**; `POST /api/messages/conversations` → **503 `RATE_LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE`**. Gated on `public_config.modules.enableMessagesModule === true`; `POST /api/admin/settings/public_config` rejects the payload shape (`400 Unsupported settings category or payload`)

testCases.label: admin financial authz
testCases.recordedEvidence: `POST /api/admin/payments/refund` → **403 `FORBIDDEN`** for a non-admin identity, **400 `INVALID_PAYMENT_ORDER`** for SUPER_ADMIN (route reachable, input validated). `GET /api/admin/payment-orders` → **503** `Payment ledger is unavailable` (DB)

testCases.label: checkout rejection path
testCases.recordedEvidence: `POST /api/pay` → **400 `INVALID_PLAN`**; `POST /api/razorpay/create-order` → **400 `CLIENT_PAYMENT_IDENTITY_REJECTED`** ("Payment ownership and amounts are server-controlled"); `POST /api/paypal/create-order` → **503 `PAYMENT_CONFIGURATION_UNAVAILABLE`**. The server **rejects** rather than fabricating, so FS-M8A-01's fabrication is confined to the client

testCases.label: interview voice
testCases.recordedEvidence: needs microphone permission and a real browser; repo-wide search finds 0 media/speech APIs in `frontend/src`

testCases.label: blog / cover-letter editors
testCases.recordedEvidence: authoring surfaces are client-side

testCases.label: marketing interactivity
testCases.recordedEvidence: `landing.tsx` has 0 `useState`; absence of interactivity is a client-side property

testCases.label: SIEM export
testCases.recordedEvidence: claim falsified at source; nothing to execute

blockedPrerequisites.MariaDB: start a disposable MariaDB on 127.0.0.1:3306, run migrations there, point DB_HOST/DB_USER/DB_PASSWORD at it; unblocks T6/T7/T11/T8b persistence legs
blockedPrerequisites.browser: install Playwright Chromium and run the dev server; unblocks every -UI case
blockedPrerequisites.Firebase: supply identity credentials (or run the emulator) to unblock T8b
blockedPrerequisites.payment providers: sandbox keys only; no real charge may be made
blockedPrerequisites.messaging: requires public_config.modules.enableMessagesModule=true, which the settings route rejects in this build (400)
